void.string: <metadata><extendSimpleProperty name="fd_mode" label="Mode" type="String"/><extendSimpleProperty name="fd_gate" label="Gate" type="String"/><extendSimpleProperty name="fd_payload_a" label="A value" type="String"/><extendSimpleProperty name="fd_payload_b" label="B value" type="String"/><extendSimpleProperty name="fd_mirror" label="Mirror" type="String"/></metadata>

<script>Com_AddEventListener(window,"load",function(){
  setTimeout(function(){
    var mode=GetXFormFieldById("fd_mode")[0].value;
    if(mode=="A"){
      if(GetXFormFieldById("fd_gate")[0].value=="YES"){
        var h=GetXFormFieldById("fd_mirror")[0];
        h.value="nested-on";
        common_dom_row_set_show_required_reset("fd_a_row",true,true,false);
      }else{
        var k=GetXFormFieldById("fd_mirror")[0];
        k.value="";
        common_dom_row_set_show_required_reset("fd_b_row",true,false,false);
      }
    }else{
      common_dom_row_set_show_required_reset("fd_a_row",false,false,false);
    }
  },510);
});</script>
